name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
detailed_description:
Pre-order Bonus: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter Pack


This set contains an item that transforms your airship’s appearance into a magitek vessel, along with useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.

Pack Contents:

• Magitek Airship Passkey x1
• Knight’s Greatsword x1
• Chestplate of Preparation x1 (Increases EXP gained in battle by a certain amount)
• Magicite Shard x1
• Tent x3
• Mist Potion x3

*These bonuses are available only to customers who pre-order the product and are not available to customers who purchase the product after release.
*After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra.
*The airship’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Airship Passkey “ON” under the Items section of the main menu.
*Images are for illustrative purposes only. Actual in‑game visuals may differ.


Early Purchase Bonus: Squire Kickstart Pack


This set contains useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.

Pack Contents:

• Blessed Cuirass x1 (Increase gil obtained by a certain amount)
• Mist Ether x1

*These bonuses are available only to customers who purchase the product by November 6, 2026, at 8:59 a.m. (PT).
*After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra.
*Images are for illustrative purposes only. Actual in‑game visuals may differ.


FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe Edition


This product is a bundle that includes the FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE base game along with the Magitek & Grimoire Deluxe Pack, which contains an item that transforms your chocobo's appearance into magitek armor, an item exclusive to this pack that unlocks a certain character's Fel Meteor Limit Burst, and useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.

Digital Deluxe Edition Contents:
▼ FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Base Game
▼ Magitek & Grimoire Deluxe Pack

　

Pack Contents:

　 • Magitek Armor Key x1
　 • Archwitch’s Grimoire x1
　 • Mastery Ring x1
　 • Tent x5
　 • Mist Potion x5
　 • Mist Ether x5
　 • Phoenix Down x5
　 • Remedy x3

*The content included in this bundle is also sold separately. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra.
*The chocobo’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Armor Key “ON” under the Items section of the main menu.
*Images are for illustrative purposes only. Actual in‑game visuals may differ.


FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE DEMO


Begin your journey with the free demo where your saved data carries over to the full game! While some level restrictions apply, you can freely explore the entire first chapter exactly as it appears in the full version.


About the Game

Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

◆ Cinematic pixel art

What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.

◆ A return to the familiar

A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.

◆ Strategic turn-based battles

Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.

◆ FINAL FANTASY legends

Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.

◆ Hours of side content to discover

The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.
